The '''DT-16 "Destructor" battle droid''' was a combat [[Droid/Legends|droid]].

==History==
Made by one of the smaller droid manufacturers, the DT-16 wasn't widely used in the [[Mandalorian Wars]]. It was popular with [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] and local militias.

==Characteristics==
The DT-16 was tall and broad, built like a muscled humanoid. It had integrated blaster rifles concealed in its arms which could be quickly deployed out of its arms and used in conjunction with its hands. The chest held a dual [[Grenade launcher/Legends|grenade launcher]] system behind a sliding panel which was connected to a 12 round magazine.

It could be modified for several different purposes. One modification was an anti-vehicle defense droid. This was done by mounting [[Missile launcher/Legends|missile launchers]] on the shoulders of the DT-16. It could also be modified to be a [[Sentry droid/Legends|sentry droid]]. This modification required adding a [[Glowrod/Legends|glowrod]] and [[Night vision/Legends|darkvision]]. It also replaced the frag grenades with [[Stun grenade/Legends|stun grenades]].<ref name="sgd" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''[[Scavenger's Guide to Droids]]'' states the DT-16 was made by DroidWorks, but doesn't specify if it was [[Farrfin Droidworks]] or [[TransTech Droidworks/Legends|TransTech Droidworks]].
